title: FacePlex: Full-Duplex Joint Speech-Facial Motion Generation for Conversational Avatars
title_zh: FacePlex：面向对话式 Avatar 的全双工联合语音-面部运动生成
abstract_en: Natural face-to-face conversation requires real-time speech generation together with synchronized facial motion. Existing systems only partially address this problem: speech-only full-duplex models can generate speech in real time but do not produce facial motion, while audio-driven facial motion models animate a face from already available audio rather than jointly generating speech and motion online. To bridge this gap, we first formalize full-duplex joint speech-facial motion generation, where speech tokens and facial motion tokens are produced together every step. Building on this formulation, we propose FacePlex, a unified streaming framework with two key components. First, Rolling Flow Matching adapts flow matching to online motion generation by committing new motion frames at each streaming step. Second, Rolling Cross-Attention couples the streaming audio queue with the motion queue, allowing speech and facial motion to condition each other as generation progresses. Through extensive experiments, ablation studies, and a user study, we show that FacePlex enables full-duplex joint speech-facial motion generation under online streaming constraints, while achieving stronger lip-sync quality and motion fidelity than audio-driven facial motion baselines.
abstract_zh: 自然面对面对话需要实时生成语音，并同步产生面部运动。现有系统通常只解决其中一部分：speech-only full-duplex 模型能实时生成语音但不生成面部动作；audio-driven facial motion 模型则依赖已给定音频来驱动人脸动画，无法在线联合生成语音与运动。本文首先形式化定义了全双工联合语音-面部运动生成任务，即在每个流式步骤同时生成 speech tokens 与 facial motion tokens。基于该设定，作者提出 FacePlex，一个统一的流式生成框架，包含两个关键组件：Rolling Flow Matching 将 flow matching 适配到在线运动生成，通过每个流式步骤提交新的运动帧；Rolling Cross-Attention 将流式音频队列与运动队列耦合，使语音与面部运动在生成过程中相互条件化。大量实验、消融实验与用户研究表明，FacePlex 能在在线流式约束下实现全双工联合语音-面部运动生成，并在唇同步质量与运动保真度上优于 audio-driven facial motion 基线。
key_points_zh: 提出 full-duplex joint speech-facial motion generation 任务设定：在在线流式对话中，每一步同步生成语音 token 与面部运动 token。
FacePlex 是统一的 streaming framework，可让 conversational avatar 在生成语音的同时产生同步面部动作，而非事后由音频驱动动画。
Rolling Flow Matching 将 flow matching 改造为适合在线运动生成的形式，通过逐步提交新 motion frames 满足流式约束。
Rolling Cross-Attention 连接 streaming audio queue 与 motion queue，使语音与面部运动在生成过程中双向条件化、相互协调。
实验、消融与用户研究显示，FacePlex 在 lip-sync quality 和 motion fidelity 上优于传统 audio-driven facial motion baselines。

llm_assessment.comment: A technically novel streaming full-duplex speech-and-face generation framework for conversational avatars, though its relevance to tool-using realtime agents is indirect.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作提出了较新颖的流式全双工语音与面部动作联合生成框架，但与工具型实时智能体的关系较为间接。
